name: radio-group
description: A single-choice group: RadioGroup (role=radiogroup) plus Radio items that are native <input type="radio"> sharing one name, so the browser gives arrow-key navigation and single-selection for free. Controlled via value + onValueChange. Pair each Radio with a label.

notes: The group is a role=radiogroup; label it with aria-label or aria-labelledby
Native radios sharing a name get roving focus and arrow-key selection from the browser
Each option needs a label (wrapping <label> or field); options show a visible focus-visible ring

intents: a radio group / single-choice option list
pick one of several mutually exclusive options
examples: <RadioGroup value={plan} onValueChange={setPlan} aria-label="Plan"><label><Radio value="free" /> Free</label><label><Radio value="pro" /> Pro</label></RadioGroup>
